The full licence text is at https://openfontlicense.org and is reproduced in
every distribution of the font from Google Fonts.

Under the OFL, self-hosting is permitted. The two obligations are that the
licence travels with the font — which is what this file is — and that the font
is not sold on its own. Neither is affected by serving it from this domain.

Files here:
  rajdhani-400-latin.woff2   regular, latin subset  — body text
  rajdhani-700-latin.woff2   bold, latin subset     — body text
  orbitron-700-latin.woff2   bold, latin subset     — the wordmark only

Latin only, and only the two weights the stylesheets use. The page used to
request five weights of Rajdhani plus three of Orbitron, across devanagari,
latin-ext and latin — around eight files, of which two were ever drawn.
